uncertain: Dashed cave network preserves documented junctions and the Temple Hall loop; exact cave outlines, ledges and passage bends remain unverified.
Temple Hall stair/ramp alignment is approximate; the arrow indicates local level change only. Unverified jump shortcuts are omitted.
Q6 and Q7 are approximate object positions near Galgann Firehammer.
The short southeastern dead-end represents Annora’s chamber; no trainer marker is used because the allowed marker set has no trainer symbol.
notes: Schematic connectivity, not to scale. Dashed corridor edges indicate unverified bends, widths or local stair geometry; endpoints follow the documented connections.
Letters identify paired transitions. E marks an instance entrance; no exterior dungeon rooms are included.
The rear entrance is a normal second portal, not a teleporter.
Q5 and Q8 are boss drops; their markers are placed adjacent to the relevant encounter. Q6 and Q8 also serve Find the Gems and Power Source.
Suggested route visits Obsidian Sentinel, Temple Hall, Galgann Firehammer and Grimlok, then continues to Hall of the Crafters.
The western tunnel bypasses the Temple Hall excursion and rejoins the northern network.
